title: From Alert Floods to Precedence Forests: Zero-Prior-Knowledge Incident Triage with LOGOS
title_zh: 从警报洪流到先序森林：基于 LOGOS 的零先验知识事件分类

paragraphs.en: Commercial observability platforms rely on domain artifacts like distributed traces, topology maps, and baseline metrics. However, when troubleshooting proprietary software, enterprise operators are left with only raw, unannotated text logs. We explore the extreme boundary of log-only diagnosis: To what extent can we isolate failure propagation using strictly raw text logs? We present LOGOS, an unsupervised system that exploits entity-event co-occurrence and temporal precedence to collapse millions of raw log lines into a compact precedence forest. Evaluated across 25 production enterprise outages and 12 open-source issues, LOGOS operates with zero prior knowledge—requiring no seed queries, observed symptoms, or pre-defined incident boundaries. In a median wall-time of 4.5 minutes, LOGOS eliminates a median 99.8 % 99.8\% of background noise, achieves 0.76 0.76 mean recall, and detects failure cascades with a 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead time—consolidating alert floods 124 × 124\times to enable 80 % 80\% enterprise ( 100 % 100\% open-source) zero-shot LLM root-cause accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 商业可观测性平台依赖于领域特定的人工制品，例如分布式追踪、拓扑地图和基线指标。 然而，在排查专有软件问题时，企业运维人员只能依赖未经标注的原始文本日志。 我们探索了仅依赖日志的诊断极限：仅使用原始文本日志，我们能多大程度地隔离故障传播？ 我们提出了 LOGOS——一种无监督系统，它利用实体与事件的共现关系及时间先后顺序，将数百万条原始日志行压缩为紧凑的先后顺序森林。 在 25 起企业生产环境中断事件和 12 个开源问题上的评估表明，LOGOS 无需任何先验知识即可运行——既不需要初始查询、观察到的症状，也不需要预定义的故障边界。 LOGOS 的中位实际运行时间为 4.5 分钟，能够消除中位数 99.8% 的背景噪声，实现 0.76 的平均召回率，并以 16 小时的中位诊断验证前置时间检测出故障级联效应——从而将告警洪流压缩 124 倍，使企业（以及开源场景）的零样本 LLM 根本原因分析准确率提升至 80%。

paragraphs.en: Modern observability platforms [ 39 , 9 , 12 ] rely on rich domain artifacts—dependency maps, distributed traces, and execution baselines—that are absent in black-box enterprise deployments. Enterprise IT administrators lack the source code, vendor-specific domain expertise, and incident history required to inspect proprietary vendor binaries, while vendor engineering teams lack visibility into the customer’s private deployment state until an outage surfaces [ 44 , 19 , 46 ] . This creates a double bind : troubleshooting guides and runbooks quickly become stale [ 19 , 14 , 40 , 37 ] , and emergent cross-vendor failures fall outside any single vendor’s source code or documentation. Consequently, enterprise debugging remains overwhelmingly manual [ 40 ] . While recent AIOps pipelines [ 22 , 37 , 8 , 42 , 49 , 44 , 36 ] attempt to automate triage, they assume curated playbooks or historical incident archives that enterprise environments do not possess.
paragraphs.zh: 现代可观测性平台 [ 39 , 9 , 12 ] 依赖丰富的领域工件——依赖关系图、分布式追踪和执行基线——而这些在黑盒企业部署中并不存在。 企业 IT 管理员缺乏检查专有供应商二进制文件所需的源代码、特定供应商的领域知识和事件历史，而供应商的工程团队则在故障出现之前无法了解客户私有部署的状态 [ 44 , 19 , 46 ] 。 这造成了一个两难困境：故障排除指南和运行手册会迅速过时 [ 19 , 14 , 40 , 37 ] ，而跨供应商的新兴故障则超出了任何单一供应商的源代码或文档范围。 因此，企业调试仍然主要依赖人工操作 [ 40 ] 。 尽管近期的 AIOps 流程 [ 22 , 37 , 8 , 42 , 49 , 44 , 36 ] 试图实现故障分类自动化，但它们假设存在精心整理的手册或历史事件档案，而这些正是企业环境所不具备的。

paragraphs.en: Because raw text logs remain the only universally accessible artifact spanning all vendor boundaries [ 19 ] (§ 2 ), this work explores the extreme end of the spectrum: To what extent can we bound the diagnostic search space using strictly raw text logs? By establishing this lower bound—without requiring source code, distributed traces, or healthy execution baselines—log-only analysis empowers enterprise administrators to troubleshoot complex multi-vendor incidents as far as possible on their own. When severe issues exceed in-house resolution and require escalation to vendor support, this bounded representation provides a distilled, cross-vendor failure context—replacing unguided log grepping with an empirical baseline upon which enterprise operators, vendor engineers, and future AIOps pipelines can build.
paragraphs.zh: 由于原始文本日志仍然是跨越所有供应商边界的唯一通用可访问的产物 [ 19 ] (§ 2 )，本研究探索了这一光谱的极端情况：我们能在多大程度上仅通过严格使用原始文本日志来界定诊断搜索空间？ 通过确立这一下限——而无需源代码、分布式追踪或正常执行基线——仅依赖日志的分析方法使企业管理员能够尽可能独立地排查复杂的跨供应商故障。 当严重问题超出内部解决能力并需要升级至供应商支持时，这种有界表示可提供一种提炼过的跨供应商故障上下文——以经验性基线取代无指导的日志搜索，供企业操作员、供应商工程师以及未来的 AIOps 流程在此基础上构建。

paragraphs.en: Existing log-only diagnostic studies [ 45 , 30 , 51 , 11 , 33 , 50 , 28 , 16 , 17 , 21 ] rely on clean, stationary healthy baselines. However, enterprise infrastructure rarely yields such baselines: healthy telemetry is absent during new deployments and upgrades, and otherwise non-stationary, sparse, or unrecorded during normal operation [ 25 , 19 , 21 ] . Consequently, how far raw text logs alone can bound the enterprise diagnostic search space without healthy execution baselines remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的仅基于日志的诊断研究 [ 45 , 30 , 51 , 11 , 33 , 50 , 28 , 16 , 17 , 21 ] 依赖于干净、平稳的健康基准数据。 然而，企业基础设施很少能提供这样的基准数据：在新部署和升级期间缺乏健康的遥测数据，而在正常运行期间，这些数据通常不平稳、稀疏或未被记录 [ 25 , 19 , 21 ] 。 因此，在没有健康执行基准数据的情况下，仅凭原始文本日志能在多大程度上界定企业诊断的搜索空间，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our contribution. In this paper, we present LOGOS to answer this question. LOGOS is a log-only analysis system that bounds and orders the diagnostic search space by inferring approximate fault propagation across vendor infrastructure subsystems. For example, when applied to virtual infrastructure logs, LOGOS isolates latent faults like unpersisted configuration changes and infers how they propagate to disrupt virtual network bring-up.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献。 在本文中，我们提出了 LOGOS 来回答这个问题。 LOGOS 是一个仅基于日志的分析系统，它通过推断跨供应商基础设施子系统的近似故障传播，对诊断搜索空间进行界定和排序。 例如，当应用于虚拟基础设施日志时，LOGOS 能够识别出未持久化的配置变更等潜在故障，并推断这些故障如何传播进而干扰虚拟网络的启动过程。

sents.en: LOGOS is a log-only analysis system that bounds and orders the diagnostic search space by inferring approximate fault propagation across vendor infrastructure subsystems.

sents.en: For example, when applied to virtual infrastructure logs, LOGOS isolates latent faults like unpersisted configuration changes and infers how they propagate to disrupt virtual network bring-up.
sents.zh: 例如，当应用于虚拟基础设施日志时，LOGOS 能够识别出未持久化的配置变更等潜在故障，并推断这些故障如何传播进而干扰虚拟网络的启动过程。

paragraphs.en: The goal of LOGOS is to serve as a fully automated first step before an enterprise administrator begins manual triage. Therefore, LOGOS must trace faults through raw telemetry without relying on external inputs .
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 的目标是在企业管理员开始手动分类之前，充当一个完全自动化的第一步。 因此，LOGOS 必须在不依赖外部输入的情况下，通过原始遥测数据追踪故障。

paragraphs.en: To bound the search space , LOGOS eliminates background noise by leveraging system and runtime entity identifiers embedded in log text to link related events (events sharing entities) and related entities (entities co-occurring across events). Together, these form a bipartite entity-event graph; computing the transitive closure over this graph isolates related events from unrelated background noise (e.g., as illustrated by config_store in Listing 1 ). Within this graph, higher-severity events (e.g., [WARN] , [ERROR] ) denote faults, while participating identifiers represent impacted entities —either originating faults or downstream victims.
paragraphs.zh: 为了限定搜索空间，LOGOS 利用日志文本中嵌入的系统及运行时实体标识符，通过关联相关事件（共享实体的事件）和相关实体（跨事件共同出现的实体）来消除背景噪声。 这些元素共同构成一个双部实体-事件图；计算该图的传递闭包可将相关事件与无关的背景噪声区分开来（例如，如列表 1 中的 config_store 所示）。 在此图中，严重程度较高的事件（例如 [WARN]、[ERROR]）表示故障，而参与其中的标识符则代表受影响的实体——即原始故障或下游受害者。

paragraphs.en: To order the search space , LOGOS sorts impacted entities in this isolated graph by their earliest faults. However, pure chronological sorting alone does not reveal how faults propagate between entities that do not directly share a log event. To establish fault precedence from log data, LOGOS connects each impacted entity to its nearest earlier co-occurring entity in a parent-child relationship, reconstructing the failure propagation sequence .
paragraphs.zh: 为了对搜索空间进行排序，LOGOS 按照受影响实体最早出现的故障，对这些孤立图中的实体进行排序。 然而，仅凭纯粹的时序排序无法揭示那些未直接共享日志事件的实体之间，故障是如何传播的。 为了从日志数据中确定故障的先后顺序，LOGOS 将每个受影响的实体与其最近的前置共现实体通过父子关系连接起来，从而重建故障传播序列。

paragraphs.en: This log-only reconstruction is challenging for two primary reasons. First, identifying faults in logs is hard. Enterprise logs do not encode the correct severity of events. In virtual infrastructure logs, third-party vendor subsystem events are logged verbatim without assigned severities, because they do not share common logging conventions or error codes, leaving them at risk of being misclassified as benign [INFO] events. While determining exact event severity without domain knowledge is impossible, LOGOS captures these faults by elevating central subsystem logs that wrap such third-party events directly to fault candidates. Additionally, it extracts embedded severity keywords from free-form log text; for instance, the line [t0 - 37m] [INFO] management_node: Ignoring config_parse_exception[1046]: Not a non-singleton object: key alert (Listing 1 ) is promoted based on its embedded alert keyword—a heuristic we call severity elevation.
paragraphs.zh: 这种仅基于日志的重建工作存在两大主要挑战。 首先，在日志中识别故障十分困难。 企业级日志并未编码事件的正确严重程度。 在虚拟基础设施的日志中，第三方供应商子系统的原始事件会被逐字记录，但不会分配严重程度，因为它们没有共同的日志记录规范或错误代码，因此存在被误分类为良性 [INFO] 事件的风险 [1]。 尽管在没有领域知识的情况下确定确切的事件严重程度是不可能的，但 LOGOS 通过将直接封装此类第三方事件的中央子系统日志提升为故障候选项来捕捉这些故障。 此外，它还能从自由格式的日志文本中提取内嵌的严重程度关键词；例如，[t0 - 37m] [INFO] management_node: Ignoring config_parse_exception[1046]: Not a non-singleton object: key alert（列表 1）这一行，会因其内嵌的 alert 关键词而被提升——这种启发式方法我们称之为严重程度提升。

sents.en: Additionally, it extracts embedded severity keywords from free-form log text; for instance, the line [t0 - 37m] [INFO] management_node: Ignoring config_parse_exception[1046]: Not a non-singleton object: key alert (Listing 1 ) is promoted based on its embedded alert keyword—a heuristic we call severity elevation.
sents.zh: 此外，它还能从自由格式的日志文本中提取内嵌的严重程度关键词；例如，[t0 - 37m] [INFO] management_node: Ignoring config_parse_exception[1046]: Not a non-singleton object: key alert（列表 1）这一行，会因其内嵌的 alert 关键词而被提升——这种启发式方法我们称之为严重程度提升。

paragraphs.en: Second, identifying the boundary of failure propagation, especially its origin, is hard. Entity correlation alone cannot distinguish originating faulty entities from downstream victims. Blindly correlating all impacted entities across an entire multi-day log bundle inflates the search space as victims co-occur with unrelated background events. To isolate the failure origin without domain knowledge, LOGOS partitions the log timeline into uniform windows and flags fault propagation onset at the first window where correlated faults span two or more distinct subsystems—marking the start of a multi-subsystem cascade . Starting from this onset window, LOGOS correlates faults across consecutive windows, constructing a bipartite entity-event graph and computing its transitive closure to isolate independent subgraphs. LOGOS tracks the maximal connected component (the primary propagation cascade detected) and expands it until a subsequent window adds no new faults, at which point graph construction terminates. We call this process progressive onset tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，确定故障传播的边界，尤其是其源头，十分困难。 仅凭实体相关性无法区分引发故障的实体与下游受影响的实体。 在整个跨越多日的日志集合中盲目关联所有受影响实体，会导致搜索空间膨胀，因为受影响的实体常与无关的背景事件同时出现。 为在缺乏领域知识的情况下定位故障源头，LOGOS 将日志时间线划分为均匀的时间窗口，并在首个出现相关性故障跨越两个或更多独立子系统的窗口中标记故障传播的起始点——这标志着多子系统级联故障的开始。 从该起始窗口开始，LOGOS 会关联连续窗口中的故障，构建一个双实体-事件图，并计算其传递闭包以隔离独立的子图。 LOGOS 会追踪最大的连通分量（即检测到的主要传播级联），并将其扩展，直到后续窗口不再引入新故障，此时图构建过程终止。 我们将这一过程称为渐进式起始追踪。

paragraphs.en: LOGOS organizes the impacted entities in this primary cascade into parent-child relationships to reconstruct the failure propagation sequence. However, this construction is confounded by entities that occur ubiquitously in logs—such as global session identifiers or cluster-wide task handles used by management subsystems—because they co-occur with nearly all other entities. Lacking domain context, LOGOS would treat these handles as universal parent hubs, causing them to falsely appear as the root of all other faults. To prevent this structural distortion, LOGOS identifies and filters out ubiquitous entities prior to tree construction—a technique we call hub-node pruning. Removing these hub nodes partitions the cascade into a precedence forest of distinct propagation trees suited for direct human triage or AIOps synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 将此次初级级联中受影响的实体组织成父子关系，以重构故障传播序列。 然而，日志中普遍存在的实体（例如全局会话标识符或管理子系统使用的集群级任务句柄）会干扰这种构建过程，因为它们几乎与其他所有实体同时出现。 由于缺乏领域上下文，LOGOS 会将这些句柄视为通用的父节点中心，导致它们错误地表现为所有其他故障的根源。 为防止这种结构扭曲，LOGOS 在构建树状结构之前会识别并过滤掉普遍存在的实体——我们称这一技术为“中心节点修剪”。 移除这些中心节点后，级联结构会被分割成由独立传播树组成的优先序森林，适用于直接的人工分类或 AIOps 综合处理。

paragraphs.en: Log analysis is the primary diagnostic method for complex enterprise outages. Across 100 severe virtual infrastructure incidents we studied, spanning distributed enterprise datacenters across compute, storage, networking, and control planes, 56 were root-caused using logs alone, 7 required fine-grained metrics, 7 required memory core dumps, and 8 required source code analysis (primarily locking and resource contention). The remaining 22 were resolved out-of-band via upgrades or reconfigurations—a common outcome for complex enterprise issues [ 15 , 14 ] . Diagnosing the 56 log-centric issues was an inherently manual and iterative process spanning vendor support and engineering teams, averaging ∼ \sim 33 days in calendar resolution time. LOGOS directly targets the empirical cost of unguided log search by eliminating a median 99.8 % 99.8\% of background noise in a median compute wall-time of 4.5 minutes (§ 6.3 , § 6.6 )—narrowing, rather than replacing, this 33-day manual investigation. From the 56 log-centric issues, we selected 25 log-diagnosable issues for evaluating LOGOS based on complete log bundle availability and verified ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 日志分析是诊断复杂企业级中断事件的主要方法。 在我们研究的 100 起严重虚拟基础设施事件中，这些事件涉及分布式企业数据中心中的计算、存储、网络和控制器平面，其中 56 起仅通过日志确定了根本原因，7 起需要精细指标，7 起需要内存核心转储，8 起需要源代码分析（主要是锁和资源竞争问题）。 其余 22 起则通过升级或重新配置等非直接方式解决——这是复杂企业级问题的常见结果 [15, 14]。 诊断这 56 起以日志为中心的问题本身就是一个手动且迭代的过程，涉及供应商支持团队和工程团队，平均日历解决时间约为 ∼33 天。 LOGOS 直接针对无引导日志搜索的经验性成本，通过消除背景噪声的中间值 99.8%（即 99.8\%），并在计算墙时中位数 4.5 分钟内完成（§6.3, §6.6）——它缩小了这一 33 天手动调查的范围，而非取而代之。 在这 56 起以日志为中心的问题中，我们基于完整的日志包可用性和经过验证的真实数据，挑选出 25 起可通过日志诊断的问题来评估 LOGOS。

paragraphs.en: The 25 issues highlight how faults cross subsystem and vendor boundaries in complex enterprise outages. Table 1 summarizes the symptom and root-cause categories across these incidents, revealing two key characteristics. First, third-party vendor issues account for nearly two-thirds of all incidents (16 of 25). This concentration reflects the operational pain point resulting from emergent cross-vendor interactions where administrators lack source code or runbooks. Second, root causes rarely reside in the same subsystem as the observed symptom [ 35 ] and are often logged days before the final outage [ 20 ] . Consequently, diagnosing these incidents requires analyzing multi-day logs across several decoupled subsystems to trace terminal symptoms back to their originating root cause.

paragraphs.en: Enterprise Telemetry. When enterprise incident tickets are filed, administrators upload diagnostic log bundles spanning retention windows from days to weeks. Bundles encompass telemetry across control, management, and data planes, organized in directories representing clusters, with separate log files for specialized subsystems (e.g., host management daemons, hypervisor kernels, virtual storage drivers). While enterprise bundles contain heterogeneous artifacts such as memory crash dumps and metric time-series, LOGOS operates strictly on raw text logs.
paragraphs.zh: 企业遥测数据。 当企业提交事件工单时，管理员会上传诊断日志包，其保留时间窗口从数天到数周不等。 这些日志包涵盖了控制平面、管理平面和数据平面的遥测数据，按集群对应的目录进行组织，并为专用子系统（例如主机管理守护进程、虚拟机监控程序内核、虚拟存储驱动程序）单独存放日志文件。 尽管企业日志包包含内存崩溃转储和指标时间序列等异构数据，但 LOGOS 仅严格处理原始文本日志。

paragraphs.en: Each log line comprises four primary fields: a timestamp, emitting subsystem, native severity level (e.g., INFO , ERROR ), and free-form log text. Because native log levels are unreliable [ 19 ] , LOGOS applies severity elevation. Log fields are parsed using vendor-specific regular expressions, abstracting free-form text into parameterized log templates (or events ) following standard log abstraction models [ 18 ] . This abstraction condenses millions of repetitive log lines into a compact vocabulary of event patterns—each representing a distinct logging statement in the underlying code—while isolating dynamic parameters (e.g., task handles, disk IDs) to serve as entity “glue” in our bipartite graph.
paragraphs.zh: 每行日志包含四个主要字段：时间戳、发出子系统的名称、原生严重程度级别（例如，INFO、ERROR）以及自由格式的日志文本。 由于原生日志级别不可靠 [ 19 ]，LOGOS 会应用严重程度提升机制。 日志字段通过特定厂商的正则表达式进行解析，将自由格式文本抽象为参数化的日志模板（或事件），遵循标准的日志抽象模型 [ 18 ]。 这种抽象方法将数百万行重复的日志压缩成一个紧凑的事件模式词汇表——每个模式代表底层代码中的一个独立日志语句——同时将动态参数（例如，任务句柄、磁盘 ID）隔离出来，用作我们二分图中的实体“粘合剂”。

paragraphs.en: Entity Co-Occurrence. To verify whether log lines naturally link events across subsystems, we analyzed telemetry across three platforms: 25 enterprise virtual infrastructure bundles, 4 OpenStack cloud datasets [ 53 ] , and 8 TrainTicket microservice benchmarks [ 52 ] . Across all three environments, individual log lines contain multiple co-occurring identifiers ( N line > 1 N_{\text{line}}>1 , averaging 2.57 to 4.37 IDs per line). This validates our core thesis: dynamic identifiers (e.g., task handles, VM UUIDs, disk IDs) naturally appear together in log text, acting as the “glue” that stitches cross-subsystem failure paths without manual schemas or tracing headers.
paragraphs.zh: 实体共现。 为了验证日志行是否自然地连接了跨子系统的各类事件，我们分析了来自三个平台的数据：25 个企业级虚拟基础设施包、4 个 OpenStack 云数据集 [ 53 ] 以及 8 个 TrainTicket 微服务基准测试 [ 52 ]。 在所有三种环境中，单条日志行都包含多个共现的标识符（N line > 1 N_{\text{line}}>1，平均每行包含 2.57 至 4.37 个标识符）。 这验证了我们的核心论点：动态标识符（例如任务句柄、虚拟机唯一标识符和磁盘 ID）会自然地共同出现在日志文本中，充当“粘合剂”，无需手动定义模式或追踪标头即可将跨子系统的故障路径连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, attempting to convert these log lines into standard pairwise entity graphs used by traditional graph-based algorithms [ 25 , 43 , 4 ] creates dense cliques (up to 68.21 % 68.21\% overall density; Table 3 ). In practice, this O ⁡ ( M 2 ) O(M^{2}) projection bottleneck (where M M is the number of entity–event incidences in the bundle) causes standard centrality baselines to run out of memory on 9 of our 25 enterprise incident bundles ( 36 % 36\% ). LOGOS avoids this quadratic scaling by preserving the native bipartite structure between entities and log events, keeping computation linear ( O ⁡ ( M ) O(M) ) and evaluating successfully across all 25 bundles.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，试图将这些日志行转换为传统图算法所使用的标准成对实体图 [ 25 , 43 , 4 ]，会产生密集的全连接子图（整体密度高达 68.21 % 68.21\%；见表 3）。 实际上，这种 O ⁡ ( M 2 ) O(M^{2}) 的投影瓶颈（其中 M M 是数据集中实体与事件关联的次数）导致标准的中心性基准算法在我们 25 个企业级事件数据集中有 9 个因内存不足而运行失败（占 36 % 36\%）。 LOGOS 通过保留实体与日志事件之间的原生二分结构，避免了这种二次方增长问题，使计算保持线性（ O ⁡ ( M ) O(M)），并成功评估了全部 25 个数据集。

paragraphs.en: Consider a real enterprise incident where virtual machines (VMs) failed to migrate following a hypervisor upgrade. Despite state-of-the-art observability tooling and tens of gigabytes of telemetry spanning ∼ \sim 3 years, enterprise administrators could not isolate the cause. The ticket was escalated to vendor support teams and routed to core engineering, where engineers spent over a month debugging and deploying workarounds before tracing the root cause out-of-band to a product defect that prevented host configuration updates from being persisted to disk for two years.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个真实的企業事件：在一次虚拟机监控程序升级后，虚拟机（VM）未能成功迁移。 尽管拥有最先进的可观察性工具以及跨越约 \sim 3 年的数十 GB 遥测数据，企業管理员仍无法确定根本原因。 该工单被升级到供应商支持团队，并转交给核心工程部门。工程师们花费了一个多月时间进行调试和部署临时解决方案，最终通过非常规手段追溯出根本原因：一个产品缺陷导致主机配置更新在两年内都无法持久化到磁盘。

paragraphs.en: In this case study, the product defect itself is not explicitly recorded in the logs, but its downstream impact on the infrastructure is. Accordingly, it is provided strictly with the raw 20.5 million-line log bundle—requiring no starting query, observed symptom seed, or pre-defined incident boundaries.

paragraphs.en: Incident Timeline. Listing 1 shows an excerpt of the log lines capturing the incident. Two years prior ( t 0 − 2 ​ yr t_{0}-2\text{yr} ), a maintenance script ( backup_cron ) marked the host as pending reboot ( pending_reboot=1 ). Expecting an imminent reboot, the configuration store ( config_store ) silently stopped persisting new changes to disk—a latent product defect. Because the host was never actually rebooted, all subsequent configuration updates over the next two years (including virtual switch and network group renames) existed strictly in volatile RAM. Pre-upgrade log lines at t 0 − 116 ​ h t_{0}-116\text{h} and t 0 − 37 ​ m t_{0}-37\text{m} recorded early warnings of this latent state drift.

paragraphs.en: LOGOS’s Log Representation. LOGOS parses raw logs into events and entities. Severity elevation classifies all events in Listing 1 as faults, even those carrying benign [INFO] tags. Specifically, management_node ’s line is elevated because it contains the keyword alert , while boot_init ’s lines are elevated because they are logged by a central subsystem that interfaces with unstandardized third-party components. For this incident, progressive onset tracking evaluates 7.9 million log lines across a 7-day window surrounding the upgrade. LOGOS partitions this span into 2-hour tumbling windows to detect fault onset and construct the bipartite entity-event graph. Figure 1 shows an excerpt of the maximal connected subgraph isolated by computing its transitive closure (Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Linking each entity to its nearest-earlier co-occurring entity while pruning ubiquitous hub nodes transforms this bipartite graph into the precedence forest (Figure 2 ), partitioning the failure space into three distinct propagation trees. Tree A (Connected Restore Branch) is anchored at boot_init (which links upward to an excluded hardware/BMC ancestor); this branch links the database failure to the backup-restore sequence ( load_store , config_store_backup , data_file_store , data_file_backup ) and resolves two hops down to the failing switch entity ( virtsw_local_binding ). Tree B (Isolated Retrying Root) consists of add_virtual_switch_to_host , an isolated root candidate whose 13 retries share no entity tokens with Tree A, leaving it disconnected. Tree C (Pre-existing Parsing Root) is the separate, isolated root node config_parse_exception ( t 0 − 37 ​ m t_{0}-37\text{m} ). Each node in the forest encapsulates an impacted entity along with its associated co-occurring events.

paragraphs.en: While the bipartite graph in Figure 1 captures how entities and events relate structurally, the precedence forest captures the temporal unfolding of failure propagation across impacted entities. Although the root cause of the incident itself lies outside the evaluated 7-day window, the forest establishes that within this window, the configuration parsing exception ( config_parse_exception ) strictly preceded all other faults in Figure 2 . Meanwhile, failed retries by the host management daemon to attach the switch endpoint ( add_virtual_switch_to_host ) occurred concurrently with boot_init faults. This temporal precedence enables operators to reconstruct the precise sequence of runtime and system entity faults during triage.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然图 1 中的二分图捕捉了实体与事件之间的结构性关联，但先序森林则捕捉了故障在受影响的实体间随时间传播的过程。 尽管事件的根本原因本身不在所评估的 7 天窗口之外，但该森林表明，在此窗口内，配置解析异常（config_parse_exception）严格早于图 2 中的所有其他故障发生。 与此同时，主机管理守护进程尝试附加交换机端点（add_virtual_switch_to_host）的失败重试与 boot_init 故障同时发生。 这种时间上的先后顺序使得运维人员能够在故障排查过程中重建运行时和系统实体故障的确切序列。

paragraphs.en: LLM Reasoning over Topology. Because this experiment strictly withholds event text, the prompt frames the input purely as structure: it explains that the data is a forest of independent failure-propagation trees rather than a single chain, that each entity is shown only by its first- and last-occurrence timestamps and its precedence edges to other entities, and that certain entities are tagged as likely entry points (no earlier identified cause within their own tree) or terminal effects (no further downstream effect within their own tree). The model is asked to trace forward from a tagged entry point along these edges and propose a root cause and propagation path using only the graph’s own shape and entity naming—since no log content is available in this ablation, the model cannot verify that its chosen entity’s own line describes an actual fault, a limitation the response below surfaces directly.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 对拓扑结构的推理。 由于该实验严格隐藏了事件文本，提示词将输入完全框架化为结构：它说明数据是一个由独立故障传播树组成的森林，而非单一链条；每个实体仅通过其首次和最后出现的时间戳，以及与其他实体的先后关系边来呈现；某些实体被标记为可能的入口点（在其自身树中不存在更早的已识别原因）或终端效应（在其自身树中不存在更下游的影响）。 模型被要求从一个标记的入口点出发，沿着这些边进行正向追溯，并仅基于图本身的结构和实体名称提出根本原因与传播路径——由于在此消融实验中无法获取任何日志内容，模型无法验证其选定的实体所对应的描述是否确实代表一个实际故障，而以下回应直接揭示了这一局限性。

paragraphs.en: This example also highlights two gaps when applying LLM reasoning over the precedence forest. First, Gemini bridges disconnected trees into a single incident trajectory by leveraging temporal sequencing and semantic hints embedded within entity names—overriding the explicit structural boundaries maintained by LOGOS due to a lack of co-occurring entities. Although ground truth from the incident confirms that all three trees indeed stem from the same cause (unpersisted configuration updates), this behavior reveals an LLM tendency to speculate cross-tree causality beyond explicit structural evidence. Second, because the latent root cause, a product defect, was unrecorded in the log bundle, the precedence forest captures only the subsequent failure propagation, which Gemini misattributes to hardware failures and file corruption due to the absence of event text. These gaps help identify the augmentations needed for a downstream AIOps pipeline: (1) prompting must enforce explicit awareness of forest topology boundaries, and (2) event text must be included to eliminate speculative hardware failure and file corruption hypotheses. We use the event text in our subsequent evaluations (§ 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子也揭示了在基于先例森林应用 LLM 推理时存在的两个空白。 首先，Gemini 通过利用时间顺序和实体名称中嵌入的语义提示，将相互分离的树结构整合为单一的事件轨迹——这覆盖了 LOGOS 因缺乏共现实体而维持的明确结构边界。 尽管事件的真实情况证实了所有三棵树确实源于同一原因（未持久化的配置更新），但这种行为暴露出 LLM 倾向于在没有明确结构证据的情况下跨树推测因果关系。 其次，由于潜在的根本原因——一个产品缺陷——并未记录在日志包中，先例森林仅捕捉到了后续故障的传播过程，而 Gemini 因缺乏事件文本，错误地将此归因于硬件故障和文件损坏。 这些空白有助于确定下游 AIOps 流程所需的增强措施：（1）提示必须强制智能体明确意识到森林拓扑结构的边界；（2）必须包含事件文本，以消除对硬件故障和文件损坏的推测性假设。 我们在后续评估中使用了事件文本（§ 6）。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe how the key concepts introduced in Section 1 — severity elevation , progressive onset tracking , and hub-node pruning —are combined to bound and order the diagnostic search space. LOGOS is structured as a two-stage pipeline that transforms raw text logs into compact precedence forests.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们描述了如何将第 1 节中引入的关键概念——严重性提升、渐进式发作追踪和枢纽节点剪枝——结合起来，以界定和排序诊断搜索空间。 LOGOS 的结构是一个两阶段流程，可将原始文本日志转换为紧凑的先决条件森林。

paragraphs.en: First, the ingestion stage parses raw log lines into entity identifiers and log events, applying severity elevation to isolate fault candidates. Second, the graph construction stage leverages progressive onset tracking and hub-node pruning to transform these fault candidates into compact precedence forests. Table 4 summarizes the formal constructs, notation, and graph operations used across both stages.

paragraphs.en: The graph construction stage transforms the elevated fault set E E into compact precedence forests σ \sigma ( E → F ∗ → σ E\to F^{*}\to\sigma ). Progressive onset tracking (Algorithm 1 ) partitions E E into uniform temporal windows and detects fault propagation onset at the first window where correlated faults span two or more subsystems. From this onset window, it correlates faults across consecutive windows to construct a bipartite entity-event graph, computing its transitive closure to track the maximal connected component F ∗ ⊆ E F^{*}\subseteq E representing the primary failure propagation cascade (Algorithm 2 ). When a subsequent window adds no new faults to this component, graph expansion terminates. At both the initial onset and upon termination, LOGOS converts F ∗ F^{*} into a precedence forest σ \sigma via hub-node pruning and temporal edge assignment between impacted entities (Algorithm 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图构建阶段将提升故障集 E E 转换为紧凑的先序森林 σ \sigma（E → F ∗ → σ）。 渐进式起始追踪（算法 1）将 E E 划分为均匀的时间窗口，并在首个相关故障跨越两个或更多子系统的窗口中检测故障传播的起始点。 基于该起始窗口，算法通过关联连续窗口中的故障来构建一个二分实体-事件图，并计算其传递闭包以追踪表示主要故障传播级联的最大连通分量 F ∗ ⊆ E（算法 2）。 当后续窗口未向该分量添加任何新故障时，图的扩展过程终止。 在初始起始阶段和终止阶段，LOGOS 均通过枢纽节点修剪以及在受影响的实体间分配时间边，将 F ∗ 转换为先序森林 σ（算法 3）。

paragraphs.en: Progressive Onset Tracking. To detect propagating failures without assuming a known outage timestamp, LOGOS discretizes the timeline into uniform 2-hour windows ( W = ( w 0 , … , w N − 1 ) W=(w_{0},\dots,w_{N-1}) , T w = 2 ​ h T_{w}=2\text{h} ). These windows serve as input to progressive onset tracking (Algorithm 1 ). Across these windows, LOGOS tracks failure propagation onset , expansion , and termination to output an ordered sequence of precedence forests 𝒮 = ⟨ σ 1 , σ 2 , … ⟩ \mathcal{S}=\langle\sigma_{1},\sigma_{2},\dots\rangle , where each forest σ ∈ 𝒮 \sigma\in\mathcal{S} captures an isolated failure propagation cascade.
paragraphs.zh: 渐进式起始追踪。 为了在不假设已知故障发生时间戳的情况下检测传播中的故障，LOGOS 将时间线划分为均匀的 2 小时窗口（ W = ( w 0 , … , w N − 1 ) W=(w_{0},\dots,w_{N-1}) ， T w = 2 ​ h T_{w}=2\text{h} ）。 这些窗口用作渐进式起始追踪的输入（算法 1 ）。 在这些窗口中，LOGOS 追踪故障传播的起始、扩展和终止过程，以输出一个有序的优先森林序列 𝒮 = ⟨ σ 1 , σ 2 , … ⟩ \mathcal{S}=\langle\sigma_{1},\sigma_{2},\dots\rangle ，其中每个森林 σ ∈ 𝒮 \sigma\in\mathcal{S} 都捕捉了一个孤立的故障传播级联。

For every window scanned, progressive onset tracking constructs a bipartite entity-event graph and computes its transitive closure to evaluate candidate failure components (Line 3). An onset is flagged when the subsystem footprint of the maximal connected component F ∗ F^{*} spans two or more distinct subsystems ( | Subsystems ​ ( F ∗ ) | ≥ K comp = 2 |\text{Subsystems}(F^{*})|\geq K_{\mathrm{comp}}=2 , Line 3), signaling that correlated faults are propagating across subsystem boundaries—i.e., a cascade is forming.

paragraphs.en: Forest Sequence. At both initial onset ( s = 0 s=0 ) and upon convergence ( F s ∗ = F prev ∗ F_{s}^{*}=F_{\text{prev}}^{*} ), the algorithm invokes ConstructForest to transform the maximal failure subgraph F ∗ F^{*} into a precedence forest σ \sigma (Lines 13–14), enforcing temporal precedence across impacted entities. Capturing forests at both onset and upon convergence preserves both the initial failure cascade right after it impacts multiple subsystems, and the final cascade after convergence (or walk termination). If the walk cap K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} is reached without converging, a fallback forest is emitted for the accumulated window slice (Line 21). The search index then advances past the processed cascade ( idx ← i last + 1 \text{idx}\leftarrow i_{\text{last}}+1 , Line 23) to resume scanning. Once the primary loop completes, any trailing unexamined windows ( last_covered < N − 1 \text{last\_covered}<N-1 ) undergo a final fallback scan (Lines 25–28), returning the complete sequence of precedence forests 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .

paragraphs.en: Bounded Bipartite Subgraph Detection. DetectSubgraphs correlates input faults E E within a temporal correlation bound T c = 2 ​ h T_{c}=2\text{h} to construct a bipartite entity-event graph. Within this graph, it isolates failure propagation cascades by computing its transitive closure, returning the maximal failure subgraph F ∗ ⊆ E F^{*}\subseteq E representing the primary failure cascade (Algorithm 2 ).

paragraphs.en: LOGOS is implemented as a CPU-only pipeline in approximately 3,150 lines of Python 3.10+. It leverages Python’s concurrent.futures thread pools and pre-compiled regular expressions for parallel log ingestion, utilizing SQLite (v3.35+) to persist parsed event templates and extracted entities for retrieval by progressive onset tracking.
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 是一个仅使用 CPU 的管道，由大约 3,150 行 Python 3.10+ 代码实现。 它利用 Python 的 concurrent.futures 线程池和预编译的正则表达式进行并行日志摄入，并使用 SQLite（v3.35+）持久化存储解析后的事件模板和提取出的实体，以便通过渐进式起始时间追踪进行检索。

paragraphs.en: Vendor-Specific Log Parsing. LOGOS employs lightweight, source-specific integration modules for both enterprise environments and open-source benchmarks (OpenStack [ 53 ] , TrainTicket [ 52 ] ). Because enterprise log schemas remain stable in production, each log source requires only a one-time integration module with four components: (1) a pre-compiled regex cascade extracting the primary 4-field tuple ( timestamp , subsystem , severity , text \text{timestamp},\text{subsystem},\text{severity},\text{text} ); (2) a semantic severity elevation rule set targeting embedded error keywords and central orchestrator subsystems; (3) entity extraction patterns (e.g., config_store UUIDs in virtual infrastructure, TraceIDs/SpanIDs in TrainTicket); and (4) a hub-node blocklist G G specifying ubiquitous infrastructure handles.
paragraphs.zh: 供应商特定日志解析。 LOGOS 采用轻量级的、针对特定数据源的集成模块，适用于企业环境和开源基准测试（OpenStack [ 53 ]、TrainTicket [ 52 ]）。 由于企业日志模式在生产环境中保持稳定，每个日志源仅需一个一次性集成模块，包含四个组件：(1) 预编译的正则表达式级联结构，用于提取核心的四元组（时间戳、子系统、严重程度、文本 \text{timestamp},\text{subsystem},\text{severity},\text{text}）；(2) 语义严重程度提升规则集，针对嵌入式错误关键词和中央协调器子系统；(3) 实体提取模式（例如，虚拟基础设施中的 config_store UUID，TrainTicket 中的 TraceIDs/SpanIDs）；以及 (4) 一个中心节点黑名单 G G，用于指定普遍存在的基础设施句柄。

paragraphs.en: Intermediate Persistence & Storage. Parsed events and entities from log ingestion are streamed into per-subsystem SQLite shards in write-batch flushes of 5,000 items. This sharded write bounds ingestion memory to a flat RSS footprint regardless of raw log scale N N . The normalized event templates E E with <ENTITY> placeholders are computed per log line and stored in the database. Indexes on severity and timestamps enable fast window queries over faults ( N ′ N^{\prime} ) during progressive onset tracking, while raw log files remain on disk for lazy parameter resolution. The constructed precedence forests σ \sigma —comprising entities, event templates, and precedence edges—are persisted in the database layer for triage.
paragraphs.zh: 中间持久性与存储。 日志摄入过程中解析出的事件和实体，通过每次写入 5,000 条记录的批量刷新方式，流式传输至各子系统的 SQLite 分片数据库。 这种分片写入机制将日志摄入的内存占用限制在固定的 RSS 占用范围内，不受原始日志规模 N N 的影响。 每个日志行都会计算包含 <ENTITY> 占位符的标准化事件模板 E E，并将其存储在数据库中。 对严重程度和时间戳建立的索引，使得在渐进式故障发生追踪过程中，能够快速对故障（N ′ N^{\prime}）进行窗口查询，而原始日志文件则保留在磁盘上，用于延迟参数解析。 构建好的先序森林 σ \sigma——由实体、事件模板和先序边组成——会被持久化存储到数据库层，以用于初步分类处理。

paragraphs.en: Our work aims to address a key pain point of enterprise operators facing black-box outages: the lack of domain artifacts to diagnose incidents. This section evaluates how effectively LOGOS closes this gap by utilizing strictly raw logs across 25 enterprise outages and 12 open-source software incidents. All evaluations are conducted on a VM with 8 8 vCPUs, 256 ​ GB 256\text{~GB} RAM, running Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. LLM interpretability is evaluated using Google’s gemini-3.1-pro-preview model via the Gemini Enterprise API endpoint on Vertex AI (temperature T = 0.1 T=0.1 , default decoding parameters).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作旨在解决企业运营人员面对黑盒故障时的一个关键痛点：缺乏用于诊断事件的领域性证据。 本节评估了 LOGOS 在利用完全原始日志处理 25 起企业故障和 12 起开源软件事件方面的有效性，以此衡量其填补这一差距的效果。 所有评估均在一台虚拟机上进行，该虚拟机配备 8 个 vCPU、256 GB RAM，并运行 Ubuntu 22.04 LTS。 LLM 的可解释性通过 Google 的 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 模型进行评估，该模型通过 Vertex AI 上的 Gemini Enterprise API 端点调用（温度 T = 0.1，默认解码参数）。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation answers five core questions: (1) Search-Space Bounding: How effectively does LOGOS isolate ground-truth root causes while eliminating background noise (§ 6.1 )? (2) Diagnostic Utility: Can precedence forests enable zero-shot LLM root-cause identification without domain artifacts (§ 6.2 )? (3) Early Detection: Does progressive onset tracking provide actionable lead time and alert reduction (§ 6.3 )? (4) Sensitivity & Ablation: How do LOGOS’s parameter settings and individual design decisions impact recall, compression, and diagnostic accuracy (§ 6.5 )? (5) System Overhead: What compute and memory runtime costs does LOGOS impose (§ 6.6 )?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估回答了五个核心问题：(1) 搜索空间界定：LOGOS 在排除背景噪声的同时，能多有效地隔离真实根本原因（§ 6.1）？ (2) 诊断效用：前置森林能否在不依赖领域特定特征的情况下，实现零样本 LLM 根本原因识别（§ 6.2）？ (3) 早期检测：渐进式发病追踪能否提供可操作的预警时间并减少警报数量（§ 6.3）？ (4) 敏感性与消融分析：LOGOS 的参数设置和各项设计决策如何影响召回率、压缩率和诊断准确性（§ 6.5）？ (5) 系统开销：LOGOS 会带来多大的计算和内存运行时成本（§ 6.6）？

paragraphs.en: To explain how a root cause leads to a symptom, the precedence forest must capture not only the cause and terminal symptom, but also intermediate faults —mirroring a support engineer’s diagnostic process. Failing to capture these intermediate faults degrades recall , while placing them in trees ranked late in the forest degrades accuracy by increasing the number of candidate trees an operator must inspect.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解释根本原因如何导致某种症状，先决条件森林不仅要捕捉原因和最终症状，还要捕捉中间故障——这与支持工程师的诊断过程相一致。 未能捕捉这些中间故障会降低召回率，而将它们置于森林中排名靠后的树中则会降低准确性，因为这样会增加操作员必须检查的候选树的数量。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate recall and accuracy, we extract all impacted entities documented in vendor incident diagnoses and open-source post-mortems as ground truth (GT). Recall measures the fraction of GT terms (entity values and event metadata) retained in the extracted forest. Severity elevation isolates GT faults in 24 of 25 enterprise incidents, establishing an empirical recall ceiling of 0.96 0.96 on enterprise telemetry (versus 1.00 1.00 on open-source benchmarks); the one incident without isolated GT faults is a severity-elevation miss (1 of 25), and a further 3 of 25 incidents have zero recall because maximal cascade selection discards their root-cause subgraph (§ 8 ), which together with partial retention in the remaining incidents yields the 0.76 0.76 mean recall. Notably, all four of these zero-recall enterprise incidents (the severity-elevation miss and the three maximal-cascade-selection cases) stem from third-party components, demonstrating that unannotated third-party log streams present the steepest boundary for log-only correlation. To evaluate accuracy, we order trees in the precedence forest chronologically by their root node’s earliest fault timestamp. We quantify accuracy via Top- k k reachability —the fraction of incidents where a GT-matching tree ranks within the first k k roots examined.

paragraphs.en: Comparative Baseline Selection. We compare LOGOS against four canonical baselines that operate directly on raw telemetry without requiring pre-existing dependency maps or repeated observations (unlike Sherlock [ 4 ] ): (1) Closeness Centrality (shortest-path distance sums), (2) Personalized PageRank (random walks with seed teleportation) [ 43 , 26 ] , (3) Betweenness Centrality (shortest-path traversal density), and (4) Earliest-Temporal Order (first-seen timestamp sorting). Proprietary frameworks (e.g., RCACopilot , AIDA ) are excluded as they are closed-source. We similarly exclude log-anomaly baselines (DeepLog [ 11 ] , LogBERT [ 16 ] , LogAnomaly [ 33 ] ): they mask entity parameters into wildcards and require healthy baselines this evaluation’s incidents lack (see the LogBERT paragraph below). For strict experimental parity, all graph baselines execute on the exact same candidate graph constructed by LOGOS following severity elevation.
paragraphs.zh: 对比基线选择。 我们将 LOGOS 与四个经典基线方法进行比较，这些方法直接作用于原始遥测数据，无需预先存在的依赖关系图或重复观测（与 Sherlock [4] 不同）：(1) 邻近中心性（最短路径距离之和），(2) 个性化 PageRank（带有种子跃迁的随机游走）[43, 26]，(3) 介数中心性（最短路径遍历密度），以及 (4) 最早时间顺序（首次出现的时间戳排序）。 专有框架（例如 RCACopilot、AIDA）被排除在外，因为它们是闭源系统。 我们同样排除了日志异常检测基线方法（DeepLog [11]、LogBERT [16]、LogAnomaly [33]）：它们将实体参数掩码为通配符，并且需要正常运行的基线，而本次评估的事件中缺乏这些条件（参见下文关于 LogBERT 的段落）。 为确保严格的实验一致性，所有图基线方法均基于 LOGOS 在严重性提升后构建的完全相同的候选图执行。

Due to O ⁡ ( M 2 ) O(M^{2}) memory scaling (§ 2 ), graph baselines run out of memory on 9 enterprise incidents, completing on only 16 tractable bundles. Across them, overall baseline recall ( Recall@All ) is identical across methods within each variant ( 0.60 0.60 raw, 0.58 0.58 hub-node pruned) because all four rank the same underlying entity set. paragraphs.en: By preserving its O ⁡ ( M ) O(M) bipartite structure, LOGOS evaluates across all N = 25 N=25 incidents. Because it ranks precedence trees rather than flat entity lists, any path from an impacted entity back to its root provides a complete fault propagation chain of entities and associated log events. Consequently, LOGOS achieves 60.0 % 60.0\% Top-10 reachability and 0.76 0.76 overall recall ( 0.46 0.46 prompt-capped at 1,600 nodes) across all 25 incidents—nearly double the accuracy of graph baselines, approaching the 0.96 0.96 candidate fault isolation ceiling.

paragraphs.en: LogBERT: Healthy Baseline Requirement. To empirically ground the exclusion of stationary healthy-baseline methods, we evaluated LogBERT [ 16 ] across four datasets spanning from its intended operating regime to our target environment. To mirror live incident response, LogBERT was trained without synthetic baselines or dataset balancing. On HDFS [ 45 ] , which provides pre-partitioned block identifiers and a clean healthy-anomalous split, LogBERT achieves F ​ 1 = 0.69 F1=0.69 ( P = 0.96 P=0.96 , R = 0.54 R=0.54 ), somewhat below the published results [ 16 ] . We exclude HDFS from LOGOS’s primary evaluation because its single-subsystem failure model does not exercise cross-subsystem correlation. Outside this controlled setting, LogBERT fails to generalize. paragraphs.en: Results & Diagnostic Accuracy. As Table 7 shows, Gemini prompted with raw enterprise warning+ logs achieves Full Diagnoses in only 4/25 incidents (9/25 with Partial Diagnoses). Because 7-day raw bundles (median 55 GB) exceed context limits, this baseline evaluates a truncated stream of trailing warning+ events, meaning some baseline misses reflect context truncation rather than reasoning failure. Precedence forests increase Full Diagnoses to 10/25—tracking the 0.46 0.46 capped-recall ceiling that governs exact entity matches—while post-call subsystem annotations add 10 Partial Diagnoses, reaching 20/25 (80%) overall diagnostic accuracy. On open-source benchmarks, precedence forests raise overall accuracy from 10/12 to 12/12 (100%). This gain is notable because raw open-source log streams already fit within Gemini’s context window, proving structural distillation adds diagnostic value beyond simple token compression; the remaining gap on enterprise incidents also reflects proprietary vendor binaries omitting intermediate state that open-source stack traces expose directly. Subsystem ownership further explains this diagnostic boundary: LOGOS achieves 100 % 100\% diagnostic accuracy ( 9 / 9 9/9 Full + Partial) on incidents originating within the core infrastructure software, whereas accuracy on emergent third-party component failures is 69 % 69\% ( 11 / 16 11/16 ). Crucially, all 5 5 enterprise Misses occur on third-party software, where proprietary vendor binaries omit intermediate runtime state.

paragraphs.en: Response Consistency & Repeatability. Beyond single-execution accuracy, precedence forests significantly improve diagnostic repeatability across independent runs. Evaluating three independent trials per method on the matched population of 20 enterprise incidents (60 trials per condition), precedence forests sustain at least a Partial Diagnosis across all three trials in 18 of 20 incidents (90%), compared to only 7 of 20 (35%) for raw-log prompting. Across all 60 trial executions, precedence forests deliver at least a Partial Diagnosis in 95.0% of runs (57/60)—with 46.7% achieving a Full Diagnosis (28/60)—whereas raw-log prompting succeeds in only 35.0% of runs (21/60) and reaches a Full Diagnosis in 13.3% (8/60). While raw logs exhibit high nominal score agreement (17/20), this is driven by consistent failure (scoring zero across all three trials in 13 incidents); in contrast, precedence forests provide high-yield, repeatable diagnostic signal without trial-to-trial degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 响应一致性与可重复性。 除了单次执行的准确性之外，先序森林还能显著提升独立运行中的诊断可重复性。 在匹配的 20 个企业事件数据集上，对每种方法评估三次独立试验（每个条件共 60 次试验），先序森林在所有 20 个事件中，有 18 个（90%）的三次试验均能维持至少“部分诊断”，而原始日志提示仅能在 20 个事件中的 7 个（35%）实现这一结果。 在所有 60 次试验运行中，先序森林有 95.0% 的运行（57/60）实现了至少“部分诊断”，其中 46.7% 实现了“完整诊断”（28/60）；而原始日志提示的成功率仅为 35.0%（21/60），实现“完整诊断”的比例为 13.3%（8/60）。 尽管原始日志在名义得分上表现出高度一致（17/20），但这种一致性源于持续失败（13 个事件在所有三次试验中得分均为零）；相比之下，先序森林能够提供高产出且可重复的诊断信号，不会出现试验间的性能下降。

sents.zh: 在匹配的 20 个企业事件数据集上，对每种方法评估三次独立试验（每个条件共 60 次试验），先序森林在所有 20 个事件中，有 18 个（90%）的三次试验均能维持至少“部分诊断”，而原始日志提示仅能在 20 个事件中的 7 个（35%）实现这一结果。

sents.en: Across all 60 trial executions, precedence forests deliver at least a Partial Diagnosis in 95.0% of runs (57/60)—with 46.7% achieving a Full Diagnosis (28/60)—whereas raw-log prompting succeeds in only 35.0% of runs (21/60) and reaches a Full Diagnosis in 13.3% (8/60).
sents.zh: 在所有 60 次试验运行中，先序森林有 95.0% 的运行（57/60）实现了至少“部分诊断”，其中 46.7% 实现了“完整诊断”（28/60）；而原始日志提示的成功率仅为 35.0%（21/60），实现“完整诊断”的比例为 13.3%（8/60）。

sents.en: While raw logs exhibit high nominal score agreement (17/20), this is driven by consistent failure (scoring zero across all three trials in 13 incidents); in contrast, precedence forests provide high-yield, repeatable diagnostic signal without trial-to-trial degradation.
sents.zh: 尽管原始日志在名义得分上表现出高度一致（17/20），但这种一致性源于持续失败（13 个事件在所有三次试验中得分均为零）；相比之下，先序森林能够提供高产出且可重复的诊断信号，不会出现试验间的性能下降。

paragraphs.en: Alert floods slow down incident detection and response by overwhelming enterprise administrators, allowing developing issues to go unnoticed for days before an outage. To be effective, progressive onset tracking must detect failures early and provide fewer, more meaningful alerts that connect system faults while bounding the diagnostic search space.
paragraphs.zh: 警报泛滥会淹没企业管理员，导致事件检测与响应速度变慢，使潜在问题在系统中断前数日未被察觉。 要实现有效监控，渐进式故障追踪必须尽早发现故障，并提供数量更少但更具意义的警报，以关联系统故障并限制诊断搜索范围。

paragraphs.en: Each precedence forest constructed during progressive onset tracking acts as a discrete alert—generating two forests per walk (one at onset and another upon convergence). To measure detection earliness, we evaluate the earliest temporal checkpoint at which a precedence forest enables a real LLM call to reach its highest DQ for that incident. To evaluate alert reduction, we compare raw administrator alert volume over a 7-day window against total generated forests. Finally, to establish search-space reduction, we compare total 7-day log event volume against the event count in the final, maximal precedence forest.
paragraphs.zh: 在渐进式触发追踪过程中构建的每个优先序森林都充当一个独立的警报——每次行走生成两个森林（一个在触发时，另一个在收敛时）。 为了衡量检测的及时性，我们评估最早的时间检查点，在该检查点上，优先序森林使真实的 LLM 调用能够达到该事件的最高 DQ。 为了评估警报减少效果，我们将 7 天窗口内管理员收到的原始警报数量与生成的森林总数进行比较。 最后，为了确定搜索空间的缩减程度，我们将 7 天内的日志事件总数与最终最大优先序森林中的事件数量进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 summarizes our findings across the 25 enterprise incidents. For the 20 incidents with a Full or Partial Diagnosis (Table 7 ), LOGOS achieves a median diagnosis-verified lead time of 16 hours (mean 25.1h) before the reported incident timestamp ( t 0 t_{0} ). Crucially, this lead time is verified empirically by evaluating LLM DQ (§ 6.2 ) across every forest alert generated during progressive onset tracking (§ 6.4 ), proving that enterprise failures incubate long before escalation and can be correctly diagnosed hours in advance. Across 22 incidents with available alert telemetry, enterprise environments logged a median of 1,658 raw alerts in their final 7 days. In contrast, LOGOS consolidates these streams into a median of 12 precedence forests over the same period (a median per-incident reduction of 124 × 124\times ), structuring individual alerts into coherent failure cascades. Finally, raw log bundles (median 55 GB, ∼ \sim 2.5 million entries) are compressed into precedence forests with a median size of 133.8 MB (1.4 MB when capped at 1,600 nodes for LLM context), delivering a median search-space reduction of 99.8%. paragraphs.en: In this incident, the outage manifested at t 0 t_{0} as VM migration failures following a hypervisor upgrade. The root cause was a latent product defect that prevented configuration updates from being persisted to disk, causing config_store to restore a stale snapshot upon reboot (§ 3 ). Prior to t 0 t_{0} , the incubating fault emitted background log alerts. At t 0 − 80 ​ h t_{0}-80\text{h} and t 0 − 56 ​ h t_{0}-56\text{h} , the LLM reading raw alerts identified only routine automated management logins, correctly classifying them as benign. In contrast, precedence forests identified the impacted subsystems as early as t 0 − 80 ​ h t_{0}-80\text{h} , achieving a Partial Diagnosis. At t 0 − 32 ​ h t_{0}-32\text{h} , the raw-alert diagnosis shifted to a false narrative, attributing the alerts to an out-of-band hardware-management daemon and network interface flapping. At t 0 − 18 ​ h t_{0}-18\text{h} (the earliest maximum-DQ checkpoint), LOGOS’s precedence forest isolated the fault’s signature to config_store . It surfaced config_store ’s read/parse errors, a virtual switch port state-save failure, and a VM disk-cache failure to achieve a Full Diagnosis 18 hours prior to the reboot. The raw-alert diagnosis at t 0 − 18 ​ h t_{0}-18\text{h} remained stuck on the hardware false narrative. At t 0 t_{0} , the outage occurred and the precedence forest maintained its Full Diagnosis anchored on config_store . In contrast, the raw-alert diagnosis abandoned the hardware story only to construct a second false narrative, blaming an in-progress hypervisor image upgrade and disabled signature verification. paragraphs.en: To enable effective diagnosis, LOGOS must fulfill three core operational objectives: (1) maximize recall under aggressive search-space reduction to fit LLM context limits, (2) suppress redundant alerts to mitigate operator fatigue, and (3) construct interpretable branching structures that explicitly capture fault propagation. We evaluated parameter sensitivity across correlation window T c T_{c} , onset window T w T_{w} , and session walk cap K walk K_{\text{walk}} using a 5-incident enterprise subset, reported next. The sweeps confirm that our defaults ( T c = 2.0 ​ h T_{c}=2.0\text{h} , T w = 2.0 ​ h T_{w}=2.0\text{h} , K walk = 15 K_{\text{walk}}=15 ) achieve reasonable trade-offs: T c T_{c} bounds edge expansion, T w T_{w} balances onset responsiveness against alert volume, and K walk K_{\text{walk}} prevents alert fragmentation by allowing transitive closures to reach natural completion. Open-source benchmarks remain unaffected because their shorter execution timelines fit comfortably within these bounds.

paragraphs.en: Finally, the walk cap K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} controls maximum depth during progressive onset tracking. As a failure spreads across time steps, the walk continues until the transitive closure naturally terminates—meaning no new correlated events appear. If K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} is too low, the walk is forcibly truncated and restarted in a new session later, creating fragmented alerts. Raising K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} allows walks to reach natural completion, expanding forest size while consolidating related activity into fewer alerts ( 31.6 → 26.0 31.6\to 26.0 alerts/incident) and improving overall recall ( 0.87 → 0.90 0.87\to 0.90 at K walk = 25 K_{\mathrm{walk}}=25 , Table 12 ). While these defaults ( T c = 2.0 ​ h , T w = 2.0 ​ h , K walk = 15 T_{c}=2.0\text{h},T_{w}=2.0\text{h},K_{\mathrm{walk}}=15 ) serve as baseline thresholds for batch evaluation, production deployments operating over continuous streaming logs must tune these bounds based on real-time stream latency and alert-volume budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，行走次数上限 K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} 用于控制渐进式起始追踪过程中的最大深度。 随着故障在时间步中传播，行走过程将持续进行，直到传递闭包自然终止——即不再出现新的相关事件。 如果 K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} 设置过低，行走过程将被强制截断，并在后续的新会话中重新开始，从而产生碎片化的警报。 提高 K walk K_{\mathrm{walk}} 的值可使行走过程达到自然终止状态，从而扩大森林规模，同时将相关活动整合为更少的警报（31.6 → 26.0 31.6\to 26.0 警报/事件），并提升整体召回率（0.87 → 0.90 0.87\to 0.90，在 K walk = 25 K_{\mathrm{walk}}=25 时，见表 12）。 尽管这些默认值（T c = 2.0 h, T w = 2.0 h, K walk = 15 T_{c}=2.0\text{h},T_{w}=2.0\text{h},K_{\mathrm{walk}}=15）可作为批量评估的基准阈值，但在持续流式日志环境中运行的生产部署必须根据实时流延迟和警报数量预算来调整这些边界。

paragraphs.en: Hub-node pruning removes ubiquitous hub entities and reduces the entity search space by a median of 2.8% (mean 14.9%); disabling pruning slightly increases raw graph recall ( 0.76 0.76 to 0.77 0.77 ), but it modestly degrades LLM DQ (Full Diagnoses drop from 10/25 to 8/25) because unpruned hub nodes appear as spurious root candidates. The current prompt’s explicit per-candidate semantic fault check makes the model robust to unpruned hub noise, though pruning still helps at the margin.
paragraphs.zh: 枢纽节点剪枝会移除普遍存在的枢纽实体，并将实体搜索空间的中位数减少 2.8%（均值为 14.9%）；禁用剪枝会略微提高原始图的召回率（从 0.76 到 0.77），但会轻微降低 LLM DQ（完整诊断结果从 10/25 降至 8/25），因为未被剪枝的枢纽节点会作为虚假的根候选项出现。 当前提示中针对每个候选项进行的显式语义故障检查，使模型对未被剪枝的枢纽噪声具有鲁棒性，尽管剪枝在边际上仍有帮助。

paragraphs.zh: 在过去二十年间，大量诊断研究都聚焦于故障定位问题。 在本项工作的背景下，以往的研究大致可分为两种主要范式：

sents.en: Over the past two decades, a rich body of diagnostic research has addressed failure localization.
sents.zh: 在过去二十年间，大量诊断研究都聚焦于故障定位问题。

sents.en: In the context of this work, prior studies broadly fall into two main paradigms:
sents.zh: 在本项工作的背景下，以往的研究大致可分为两种主要范式：

paragraphs.en: (1) Domain-Augmented Methods , which rely on pre-existing topology maps or CMDBs [ 34 , 46 , 3 , 23 ] , historical incident tickets and runbooks [ 8 , 10 , 22 , 37 ] , active instrumentation [ 38 , 2 , 35 , 47 ] , or graph-based ranking over metric/trace topologies [ 25 , 26 , 7 , 43 ] ; and
paragraphs.zh: (1) 领域增强方法，这些方法依赖预先存在的拓扑图或 CMDB [ 34 , 46 , 3 , 23 ]、历史事件工单和运行手册 [ 8 , 10 , 22 , 37 ]、主动仪表化 [ 38 , 2 , 35 , 47 ]，或基于指标/追踪拓扑的图排名 [ 25 , 26 , 7 , 43 ]；以及

paragraphs.en: (2) Statistical & Performance Inference Methods , which infer causal dependencies or isolate execution anomalies using log sequence probabilities, statistical delay distributions, or transaction success rates [ 45 , 11 , 16 , 33 , 4 , 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: （2）统计与性能推断方法：通过日志序列概率、统计延迟分布或事务成功率来推断因果依赖关系或识别执行异常 [ 45 , 11 , 16 , 33 , 4 , 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: LOGOS occupies the opposite extreme: it bounds the search space in black-box environments where neither domain artifacts, historical incident corpora, active instrumentation, nor healthy operational baselines exist. In this sense, its underlying objective is distinct: it investigates the extent to which noisy log data alone can encode failure propagation.
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 则处于完全相反的一端：它在黑箱环境中对搜索空间进行界定，而这些环境中既不存在领域内的具体要素，也没有历史事件语料、主动部署的监测工具或健康的运行基准。 从这个意义上说，其根本目标有所不同：它旨在研究仅凭噪声混杂的日志数据能够在多大程度上编码出故障的传播过程。

paragraphs.en: Domain-Augmented Methods. Among diagnostic paradigms that exploit domain artifacts, LOGOS resembles graph-based inference algorithms [ 25 , 26 , 7 , 43 ] in that it relies on the premise that failures propagate along structural dependencies best captured as a directed graph. It differs from them by deriving these structural dependencies entirely post-hoc from noisy log data rather than relying on high-fidelity time-series metrics, active network probing, or pre-existing topology maps.
paragraphs.zh: 领域增强方法。 在利用领域特征的诊断范式之中，LOGOS 与基于图的推理算法 [ 25 , 26 , 7 , 43 ] 相似，因为它依赖于这样一个前提：故障会沿着结构依赖关系传播，而这些依赖关系最适合用有向图来描述。 它与这些算法的不同之处在于，它完全从含噪日志数据中事后推导出这些结构依赖关系，而不是依赖高保真的时间序列指标、主动网络探测或预先存在的拓扑图。

paragraphs.en: LOGOS is also conceptually inspired by distributed tracing and request-reconstruction frameworks [ 5 , 13 , 38 , 32 , 24 ] . While explicit tracing systems (e.g., Dapper [ 38 ] , X-Trace [ 13 ] , Canopy [ 24 ] ) require unbroken TraceID header propagation, and schema-driven tools (e.g., Magpie [ 5 ] ) depend on pre-authored event schemas to join local handles, LOGOS operates on unmodeled, local identifiers (e.g., task handles, disk IDs) that are frequently noisy, fragmented, or missing. LOGOS overcomes this fragmentation without schemas or headers by exploiting identifier co-occurrence across intermediate log events to stitch failure paths together transitively across subsystem boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 的概念也受到了分布式追踪和请求重构框架的启发 [ 5 , 13 , 38 , 32 , 24 ] 。 虽然显式追踪系统（例如 Dapper [ 38 ]、X-Trace [ 13 ]、Canopy [ 24 ]）需要不间断地传播 TraceID 标头，而基于模式的工具（例如 Magpie [ 5 ]）则依赖预先定义的事件模式来关联本地句柄，但 LOGOS 则基于未经建模的本地标识符（例如任务句柄、磁盘 ID）运行，而这些标识符通常存在噪声、碎片化或缺失的问题。 LOGOS 无需模式或标头即可克服这种碎片化问题，它通过利用中间日志事件中标识符的共同出现，在子系统边界之间以传递方式拼接故障路径。

paragraphs.en: Other diagnostic frameworks rely on explicit request instrumentation, static code analysis, fault injection, or pre-built network topology maps [ 38 , 47 , 35 , 34 , 6 , 2 , 3 ] . Most closely related in intent to our alert-reduction mechanism is SkyNet [ 46 ] , which aggregates alert floods from passive monitoring telemetry; however, SkyNet requires known network topology and hierarchy maps to group alerts, whereas LOGOS performs event correlation completely independent of system topology.
paragraphs.zh: 其他诊断框架依赖显式请求仪器化、静态代码分析、故障注入或预构建的网络拓扑图 [ 38 , 47 , 35 , 34 , 6 , 2 , 3 ] 。 在意图上与我们警报减少机制最接近的是 SkyNet [ 46 ] ，它从被动监控遥测数据中聚合警报洪流；然而，SkyNet 需要已知的网络拓扑和层级图来对警报进行分组，而 LOGOS 则完全独立于系统拓扑执行事件关联。

paragraphs.en: Finally, LOGOS intersects with recent generative AI and agentic AIOps frameworks [ 22 , 37 , 8 , 42 , 49 , 44 , 36 ] . Like AIDA [ 44 ] and Xihe [ 36 ] , LOGOS recognizes that failure propagation is best encoded as a directed graph rather than flat entity lists. However, unlike frameworks requiring pre-authored playbooks [ 22 , 37 ] or historical ticket corpora [ 8 , 10 ] , LOGOS operates with zero historical domain knowledge. LOGOS complements these frameworks by converting raw log streams into compact precedence forests to provide bounded context for LLMs when playbooks do not exist and raw logs exceed context windows.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，LOGOS 与近期的生成式人工智能和智能体 AIOps 框架 [ 22 , 37 , 8 , 42 , 49 , 44 , 36 ] 实现了交叉融合。 与 AIDA [ 44 ] 和 Xihe [ 36 ] 类似，LOGOS 认识到，将故障传播编码为有向图比编码为扁平化的实体列表更为有效。 然而，与需要预先编写的操作手册 [ 22 , 37 ] 或历史工单语料库 [ 8 , 10 ] 的框架不同，LOGOS 无需任何历史领域知识即可运行。 LOGOS 通过将原始日志流转换为紧凑的先序森林来补充这些框架，从而在不存在操作手册且原始日志超出上下文窗口时，为 LLM 提供有限的上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: We do not benchmark directly against agentic LLM-RCA systems: each relies on a closed, organization-specific incident corpus with no public implementation, and faithfully reproducing them would require curated incident-handler libraries and historical ticket archives—artifacts whose absence is this paper’s core premise. Synthesizing such resources would test a different, better-instrumented regime than the zero-prior-knowledge environment LOGOS targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并未直接与智能体驱动的 LLM-RCA 系统进行比较基准测试：每个系统都依赖封闭且特定于组织的事故语料库，且没有公开的实现；要忠实地复现这些系统，则需要精心整理的事故处理程序库和历史工单档案——而这些正是本文核心前提所缺失的要素。 合成此类资源将检验一种与 LOGOS 所针对的零先验知识环境截然不同的、具备更好监控机制的系统模式。

paragraphs.en: LOGOS differs in two ways: it assigns precedence edges directly from single instances of entity co-occurrence (individual log lines carry more than one entity, N line > 1 N_{\text{line}}>1 ; Table 3 ) rather than statistical aggregation across thousands of repeated transactions, and it explicitly leverages dynamic entity identifiers as relational glue rather than masking them as wildcards [ 29 , 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LOGOS 在两个方面有所不同：它直接从实体共现的单个实例（单个日志行包含多个实体，N 行 > 1 N_{\text{line}}>1；表 3）中分配优先边，而不是对成千上万次重复交易进行统计汇总；此外，它还明确利用动态实体标识符作为关系粘合剂，而非将其掩码为通配符 [29, 19]。

paragraphs.en: Log Parsing. LOGOS abstracts log text into parameterized templates using lightweight vendor integration modules (§ 5 ), following standard log abstraction paradigms [ 18 , 31 , 27 , 48 ] . This module adds a one-time, per-vendor engineering cost. Incomplete parameter masking can misclassify identical logs as distinct events, inducing template fragmentation that transitive closure overcomes via shared entities. Separately, an uncaptured log-level keyword in 1 of 25 incidents prevented severity elevation from isolating its ground-truth fault, so ground truth is detectable in only 24 / 25 24/25 incidents; this caps mean enterprise recall at 0.96 0.96 .
paragraphs.zh: 日志解析。 LOGOS 通过轻量级的供应商集成模块（§ 5），遵循标准的日志抽象范式 [ 18 , 31 , 27 , 48 ]，将日志文本抽象为参数化模板。 该模块会增加一次性的、按供应商计算的工程成本。 不完整的参数掩码可能导致相同的日志被错误分类为不同事件，从而引发模板碎片化问题；通过共享实体进行传递闭包可解决此问题。 此外，在 25 起事故中，有 1 起因未捕获的日志级别关键词，导致严重程度提升无法识别其真实故障根源，因此仅在 24 / 25（24/25）起事故中能够检测到真实情况；这使得企业平均召回率的上限为 0.96（0.96）。

paragraphs.en: Ground-Truth and Scoring Boundaries. Ground-truth entities and subsystems were reconstructed directly from vendor incident reports and escalation logs rather than synthetic labeling, reflecting real-world operational diagnoses. Our scoring harness enforces strict entity identifier matching for Full Diagnoses to prevent substring false positives; consequently, a response that correctly identifies the root failure mechanism without citing specific entity tokens is conservatively scored as a Partial Diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 真实值与评分边界。 真实值实体和子系统直接根据供应商的事故报告和升级日志重建，而非通过合成标注，从而反映了现实世界中的运行诊断。 我们的评分框架对完整诊断强制执行严格的实体标识符匹配，以防止子字符串导致的误判；因此，若响应正确识别了根本故障机制但未引用具体的实体标记，则会被保守地评为部分诊断。

paragraphs.en: Third-Party Subsystem Boundary. Third-party vendor software represents the engine’s primary visibility limit: while LOGOS achieves 100 % 100\% accuracy ( 9 / 9 9/9 ) on native infrastructure faults, accuracy drops to 69 % 69\% ( 11 / 16 11/16 ) on third-party components, accounting for all 5 5 diagnostic misses. paragraphs.zh: 第三方子系统边界。 第三方供应商软件构成了该引擎的主要可见性限制：尽管 LOGOS 在原生基础设施故障上的准确率达到 100%（9/9），但在第三方组件上的准确率则降至 69%（11/16），这导致了全部 5 次诊断遗漏。 针对各供应商的自定义解析模块以及有目的的严重性提升，是提升异构企业部署中这一基准水平的主要工程手段。

paragraphs.en: The Gap to Self-Healing. LOGOS exploits structural and temporal correlation, not causality; leveraging it for automated remediation requires domain reasoning to bridge this gap before executing corrective actions.
paragraphs.zh: 与自我修复之间的鸿沟。 LOGOS 利用的是结构和时间相关性，而非因果关系；要利用它实现自动修复，就需要通过领域推理来弥合这一鸿沟，然后再执行纠正措施。

paragraphs.en: Telemetry Gaps. When network hardware lacks text logging or adjacent domains use disjoint identifier schemes, transitive closure cannot complete and the precedence forest fractures at the unlinked boundary; silent infrastructure failures remain unrecoverable from logs alone, requiring multi-modal telemetry (topology maps, metric anomalies) to bridge these gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 遥测数据缺失。 当网络硬件缺乏文本日志记录，或相邻域使用相互独立的标识符方案时，传递闭包无法完成，优先序森林会在未连接的边界处断裂；此时，仅凭日志无法恢复那些静默的基础设施故障，必须借助多模态遥测数据（拓扑图、指标异常）来填补这些缺失环节。

paragraphs.en: This work shows that log-only failure diagnosis holds strong promise in enterprise domains with rich logging. By eliminating a median 99.8 % 99.8\% of background noise in a median wall-time of 4.5 minutes while retaining 0.76 0.76 mean recall, LOGOS demonstrates that aggressive search-space reduction is achievable on raw text logs alone. Operating on 2-hour log windows, its 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead time and 124 × 124\times consolidation into structured, fault-linking alerts establish a viable design point for AIOps: rather than requiring pre-built domain artifacts or historical baselines, its compressed failure graphs support both zero-shot LLM root-cause identification ( 80 % 80\% enterprise, 100 % 100\% open-source; § 6.2 ) and direct operator triage. LOGOS is currently being integrated into the AIOps pipeline of an enterprise cloud provider to automate incident triage and accelerate ticket resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作表明，仅依赖日志的故障诊断在拥有丰富日志记录的企业领域具有巨大潜力。 LOGOS 在平均耗时 4.5 分钟的情况下，消除了中位数 99.8% 的背景噪声，同时保持了 0.76 的平均召回率，证明了仅通过原始文本日志即可实现大幅度的搜索空间缩减。 LOGOS 以 2 小时的日志窗口为输入，其经诊断验证的中位领先时间为 16 小时，并能将结果整合为结构化且关联故障的警报（整合效率提升 124 倍），这为 AIOps 确立了一个可行的设计方向：无需预构建领域特定的人工制品或历史基线，其压缩后的故障图既支持零样本 LLM 根因识别（企业场景 80%，开源场景 100%；§6.2），也支持运维人员直接进行初步排查。 LOGOS 目前正在被集成到某企业级云提供商的 AIOps 流程中，以实现事件处理的自动化并加快工单解决速度。
